changeSet.author: edward
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ${databaseName}.MART.V_ROAMING_ADJUSTMENT_SUMMARY AS SELECT BILL.BILLING_CYCLE_START, BILL.CURRENCY_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT BILL.BILL_LINE_ID) AS ROAMING_CHARGE_COUNT, SUM(BILL.NET_AMOUNT) AS ROAMING_CHARGE_AMOUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT ADJUSTMENT.ADJUSTMENT_ID) AS ADJUSTMENT_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(ADJUSTMENT.ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT), 0) AS ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT FROM ${databaseName}.CORE.FACT_BILL_LINE BILL LEFT JOIN ${databaseName}.CORE.FACT_ADJUSTMENT ADJUSTMENT ON BILL.BILL_LINE_ID = ADJUSTMENT.BILL_LINE_ID WHERE BILL.CHARGE_TYPE_CODE = 'ROAMING' GROUP BY BILL.BILLING_CYCLE_START, BILL.CURRENCY_CODE
